haToken.title: Long-Lived Access Token
haToken.description: Generate in HA: Profile → Long-Lived Access Tokens

webhookPort.title: Inbound Webhook Port
webhookPort.description: Port this plugin listens on for state changes pushed from Home Assistant

debounceMs.title: Debounce Period (ms)
debounceMs.description: How long to wait after the last position update before forwarding to HA. Prevents flooding during blind movement.

stateCachePath.title: State Cache File Path
stateCachePath.description: Optional path to persist last-known positions across restarts (e.g. /var/lib/homebridge/ha-sync-state.json)

homebridgeName.title: Homebridge Accessory Name
homebridgeName.description: Must match exactly the name shown in Homebridge logs (e.g. 'Blinds 7')
